mq: A professional extractor infiltrates a target's dreams to steal corporate secrets, then is hired to plant an idea instead; the team descends through dream levels within dreams.
A grieving thief haunted by his dead wife and a team of specialists (architect, forger, chemist) work for a businessman who promises to let him go home to his children.
Surreal dream worlds: collapsing cities, zero-gravity fights in a hotel corridor, snowy fortress, shifting time between nested dream layers; tense heist-thriller tone.
hyde: Dom Cobb is a skilled thief who extracts valuable secrets from people's subconscious while they dream. Saito, a powerful businessman, offers him a chance to return to his children if he can perform inception, planting an idea in the mind of a rival heir. Cobb assembles a team including an architect, a forger and a chemist, and they enter a shared dream. They descend through several nested dream levels, each with a different time flow, while Cobb's guilt over his dead wife Mal projects into the dreams and threatens the mission. The team must escape before the layers collapse and leave them lost in limbo.

mq: An aging Italian-American mafia patriarch is shot in an assassination attempt, and a rival family war breaks out among the crime families of New York.
A youngest son, a decorated war veteran who wants no part of the family business, is drawn in to protect his father and avenge him, and becomes cold and ruthless.
Dark, slow, operatic crime saga spanning weddings, restaurants, betrayals and baptisms in 1940s New York and Sicily.
hyde: Vito Corleone, the head of a powerful New York crime family, refuses to enter the narcotics trade and is shot down by a rival clan. His youngest son Michael, a war hero who has kept away from the family business, kills the rival and a corrupt police captain, then hides in Sicily. When his older brother Sonny is murdered, Michael returns and takes control of the family. He ruthlessly eliminates his enemies and consolidates power, losing his innocence and his wife's trust in the process.

names.title: Once Upon a Time in America

mq: A wealthy young woman engaged to a arrogant fiance falls for a penniless artist who won his ticket in a card game aboard a luxury ocean liner on its first voyage.
Two lovers from different social classes, a society girl and a drifter who sketches, try to survive and stay together as the ship hits an iceberg and sinks.
Epic disaster romance on the Atlantic, 1912, first-class dining rooms and steerage dances, freezing water, lifeboats and tragedy.
hyde: In 1912, Rose, a young upper-class woman trapped in an engagement she does not want, boards the luxurious ship on its maiden voyage across the Atlantic. She meets Jack, a poor artist who won his third-class ticket in a poker game, and they fall deeply in love. When the ship strikes an iceberg, they struggle to reach lifeboats while the fiance and his servant pursue them. As the ship sinks, Jack saves Rose's life at the cost of his own.

mq: A poverty-stricken family living in a semi-basement apartment gets hired one by one by a rich family after the son poses as an English tutor.
A scheming con-artist family, father, mother, son and daughter, pose as unrelated skilled workers and replace the household staff of a wealthy home.
Dark satirical thriller about class divide, a hidden basement bunker, a rainy night and a violent twist; Korean tone.
hyde: The Kim family lives in a cramped semi-basement and works folding pizza boxes. The son Ki-woo gets a job tutoring the daughter of the wealthy Park family with a forged diploma, and soon recommends his sister, father and mother under false identities. They push out the old staff and enjoy the Parks' house while the family is away. The former housekeeper returns and reveals that her husband has been secretly living in a hidden bunker beneath the house, setting off a violent chain of events.

mq: A quiet young banker is sentenced to life for the murder of his wife and her lover despite his innocence, and is sent to a harsh state prison.
Over decades, a prisoner befriends an old inmate who can get anything, helps the warden with his books, and keeps hope alive for everyone around him.
Prison drama with a patient, tunnelling escape, rain, a rock hammer, and a final reunion on a beach.
hyde: In 1947, banker Andy Dufresne is convicted of murdering his wife and her lover and sentenced to two life terms in Shawshank prison. He befriends Red, an inmate who can smuggle in almost anything, and uses his financial skills to help the corrupt warden launder money. Over the years Andy brings books and music into the prison and endures abuse. After nearly twenty years he escapes through a tunnel he has secretly dug behind a poster, exposing the warden's crimes.

mq: A cheerful insurance salesman in a perfect seaside town slowly notices strange coincidences: studio lights falling from the sky and neighbors repeating the same routines.
A man learns that his wife, best friend and family are actors, and that his entire life has been broadcast live to millions of viewers.
Satirical drama about reality television, a fake island town with a painted sky, and a boat crossing toward an exit door.
hyde: Truman Burbank lives a seemingly ordinary life in the idyllic island town of Seahaven. He gradually suspects that everyone around him is acting and that his whole world is a giant TV set, broadcast to the world since his birth. Despite the producer's attempts to keep him on the island, Truman sails a boat toward the horizon. The storm created by the show's creator fails to stop him, and he finally walks through a door in the painted sky.

mq: A smug television weatherman travels to a small Pennsylvania town to cover a groundhog festival and wakes up to the same morning every day.
A selfish man trapped in a time loop with a producer he is attracted to tries everything from crime to suicide before learning to help others.
Light romantic comedy in a snowy small town, a bed-and-breakfast, a groundhog ceremony and an alarm clock playing the same song.
hyde: Phil Connors is an arrogant TV weatherman sent to Punxsutawney to cover Groundhog Day with his producer Rita and a cameraman. He wakes up the next morning to find that it is Groundhog Day again, and again. After exploiting the loop for selfish pleasure, he falls into despair, then begins learning piano, ice sculpting and helping the townspeople. When he becomes a genuinely better person and wins Rita's love, the loop finally ends.

mq: The seven-person crew of a commercial towing spaceship wakes from hibernation to answer a distress beacon from a barren moon and brings something back on board.
A resourceful female officer, the warrant officer Ripley, faces a creature that grows in a ship's vents, killing the crew one by one, and a company android with hidden orders.
Claustrophobic sci-fi horror: dark industrial corridors, steam, a derelict alien ship, an organism bursting from a chest.
hyde: The crew of the commercial spaceship Nostromo is awakened from hypersleep when the ship's computer picks up a transmission from a nearby planetoid. Investigating, a crew member is attacked by a parasitic creature that attaches itself to his face. The alien grows rapidly and begins hunting the crew through the ship's corridors. Warrant officer Ripley learns that the company wants the creature brought back at any cost, and she is left to fight it alone.

mq: A FedEx troubleshooter's plane goes down in the Pacific; he washes ashore alone on an uninhabited island and learns to make fire and fish.
A man talks to a volleyball he calls Wilson, fights loneliness, and builds a raft to escape after years, returning to find his fiancee married.
Survival drama with a tropical island, a hand-print, a sail on a raft, and a long road back home.
hyde: Chuck Noland is a systems analyst obsessed with time who works for a courier company. When his cargo plane crashes in the Pacific, he is washed ashore on a deserted island. Alone for four years, he learns to make fire, find food and keep his sanity by befriending a volleyball he names Wilson. He builds a raft and eventually reaches a passing ship, returning home to find that his fiancee has moved on.

mq: A magazine photographer confined to his apartment in a summer heat wave passes time observing the neighbors across the courtyard through a telephoto lens.
A man in a wheelchair, his visiting girlfriend and his nurse try to prove that a salesman across the way murdered his bedridden wife.
Suspense thriller in one set: an apartment window, rear courtyard, a missing woman, a dog, and a killer who spots the watcher.
hyde: L.B. Jefferies is a news photographer stuck in his Greenwich Village apartment with a broken leg. To pass the time, he watches his neighbors through his window and notices that a salesman across the courtyard acts suspiciously after his invalid wife disappears. With the help of his girlfriend Lisa and his nurse, he gathers evidence, and the killer realizes he is being watched. The salesman comes to Jefferies's apartment to confront him.

mq: A sulky ten-year-old girl moving to a new town takes a wrong turn into an abandoned theme park, and her parents turn into pigs after eating the spirits' food.
A girl signs a contract with a witch who steals her name and works in a bathhouse for gods, befriending a masked spirit and a river god.
Hand-drawn fantasy animation of an enchanted spa, soot sprites, a dragon boy, trains over water; Japanese folklore.
hyde: Chihiro and her parents wander into a strange abandoned town, and her parents are turned into pigs after eating forbidden food. The witch Yubaba takes Chihiro's name and puts her to work in a bathhouse that serves the spirits of Japan. With help from the dragon boy Haku and the lonely spirit No-Face, she cleans a stinking river spirit and finally rescues her parents. She leaves the spirit world and returns to her own.

mq: A young ballerina is cast as both the White Swan and the Black Swan in a new production and is pressured by a controlling mother and a demanding director.
A shy, fragile dancer in New York sees hallucinations, her body changing, and a rival dancer who may be a threat or an imagined double.
Dark psychological horror in rehearsal studios, mirrors, bleeding toes, feathers, and a climax on opening night.
hyde: Nina is a dedicated dancer in a New York ballet company who wins the dual lead role in Swan Lake. She excels as the innocent White Swan but struggles with the seductive Black Swan, pushed by her director Thomas and by her possessive mother. A new dancer, Lily, seems to embody the freedom Nina lacks, and Nina starts to hallucinate and lose her grip on reality. On opening night, she dances the performance of her life with horrific consequences.

mq: A mountain village is repeatedly raided by bandits at harvest time, and the elders decide to hire hungry masterless samurai in exchange for rice.
An experienced ronin recruits six warriors, including a cocky young peasant-born swordsman, to train villagers and fortify the village.
Feudal Japan, rain, mud, black-and-white epic ending with a muddy battle against forty horsemen.
hyde: In sixteenth-century Japan a poor village learns that bandits will return to steal its crop after the barley harvest. The farmers go to town and find the ronin Kambei, who agrees to defend them with six more samurai for only food. The samurai train the villagers, build defenses and fight several battles against the bandits. After a final rainy confrontation, most of the samurai are dead, and the villagers return to their fields.

mq: A once-famous aging woman fired from her television show finds an underground medical product that promises a younger, better version of herself.
A cosmetic injection creates a new body that emerges from the back of the user; the two bodies must alternate weekly, and the rules get broken.
Gory body horror satire about beauty and fame, neon Hollywood, grotesque mutations and a bloody finale.
hyde: Elisabeth Sparkle, a faded fitness-show star, is fired on her fiftieth birthday by a vulgar producer. She tries a mysterious injection that creates a younger version of herself, Sue, and she must switch bodies every seven days. As Sue becomes famous, she steals more time, and Elisabeth grows desperate and jealous. The two spiral into a grotesque, gory collapse.

mq: A pampered young heir buys an old apartment building in a changing working-class neighborhood intending to empty it of tenants and build a modern home.
A lazy rich kid grows attached to colorful neighbors, falls in love with a local, and slowly defends them against the developer plans.
Warm urban comedy-drama about gentrification, immigrants and old residents, community, small-time landlords.
hyde: Adult son of a rich family is given a small allowance by his parents and decides to prove himself by buying a rundown tenement in a poor neighborhood. He plans to evict everyone and turn the building into a luxury home. However, he meets the eccentric tenants and begins to care for them. In the end he must choose between his plan and the community he has come to love.

mq: A young woman with childlike behaviour lives in a decaying family house on the French coast with her widowed father and a housekeeper, then a fugitive from a prison transport bus accident arrives.
A withdrawn girl and an escaped convict form a strange relationship in a secluded countryside house near the sea.
Quiet, melancholic French drama of isolation, coastal winter, a girl obsessed with her late mother.
hyde: Isabelle is a shy girl of around fifteen who lives with her widowed father and a caretaker in an old house by the sea in Brittany. A prison bus crashes nearby and one of the convicts escapes and takes shelter in the house. He and the girl slowly form an odd bond, and the household's routines are shaken. The authorities close in as the girl decides what the stranger means to her.

mq: A wealthy elderly Holocaust survivor living in a luxury Manhattan apartment is seized from the street by Israeli Mossad agents.
Agents claim he is a former Nazi death-camp doctor, and a trial in Israel tests the memory of witnesses and his insistence on mistaken identity.
Political thriller about wartime identity, courtroom drama, New York and Jerusalem, Nazi hunters.
hyde: A rich businessman in New York is kidnapped by Israeli agents who accuse him of being a notorious Nazi war criminal. He claims that he is a Jewish survivor who has been mistaken for the real criminal. In an Israeli courtroom, witnesses testify, and the question of his true identity divides the court. The verdict leaves the audience questioning whether justice has been done.

names.title: The Man in the Glass Booth

mq: A German-Jewish neurologist who fled Hitler takes charge of a British spinal-injury ward in the 1940s where patients were expected to die.
A stern doctor fights hospital bureaucracy and organizes wheelchair sports for paralysed soldiers, leading to games for the disabled.
Historical biographical drama set in a English hospital after World War II, rehabilitation, sport and recovery.
hyde: Dr Ludwig Guttmann arrives at Stoke Mandeville Hospital in England in the 1940s, where paralyzed soldiers with spinal injuries are expected to die. He introduces new approaches to treatment, including exercise and wheelchair sports. Despite resistance from the hospital staff, patients begin to regain confidence and hope. His sports festival grows into an international competition for disabled athletes.

mq: In the distant future all historical archives are wiped by a magnetic storm, so a group of travelers is sent to 1776 to retrieve the Declaration of Independence.
Three time-travel agents with unusual abilities struggle to adapt in colonial Philadelphia, meeting Founding Fathers and risking changing history.
Low-budget science fiction adventure that mixes comedy and historical drama in colonial America.
hyde: In the future, a magnetic storm destroys all records of the past, and a team of time travelers is sent back to 1776 to retrieve the founding documents. They arrive in colonial Philadelphia and meet famous figures of the American Revolution. Their mission is complicated when their equipment fails and they become entangled in the events. They must decide whether to interfere with history or let it unfold.

mq: A US Navy nuclear submarine near a polar research station is crippled by a silent, unknown vessel that sends out an electromagnetic pulse.
Researchers and military officers at an ice station discover an alien or unknown intelligence in the deep ocean, and the crew races to restore power.
Cold-war era underwater thriller, claustrophobic submarine interiors, polar ice, mysterious sonar contact.
hyde: A U.S. nuclear submarine patrolling the Arctic is suddenly disabled by an unknown underwater object. The vessel loses power and begins to sink toward the ocean floor. At a nearby polar research base, scientists detect strange signals and send a rescue team. They discover the object is of unknown origin and must decide whether to attack or communicate.

mq: A stubborn old widower Texas farmer is evicted from his farmland and decides to travel to Mexico with his grandson.
A grumpy old man, his teenage grandson and two hitchhikers they pick up travel through the border, facing the loss of the old west.
Modern western road movie, dusty farmland, trucks, border town, family and old age.
hyde: An old Texas rancher loses his land to the bank and refuses to go into a trailer park. He takes his young grandson and sets off in an old truck to find a new home in Mexico. Along the way they pick up two hitchhikers and encounter trouble. Over the journey, the grandfather and grandson come to understand each other.

mq: A heartbroken office clerk with no acting skills tries out for a minor part in a small-town amateur production of a classic play.
A director at a community theatre unexpectedly casts a novice as the lead, and the cast and local audience change his life.
Gentle comedy about amateur dramatics, rehearsals, local theatre, small-town life and self-discovery.
hyde: After being left by his girlfriend, a dull accountant joins a local amateur theatre group. He has never acted before and expects a minor part in Shakespeare. The director is impressed by his awkward honesty and gives him the lead role. Rehearsals transform his confidence, and opening night changes his life.

mq: A teenage prospect in a poor Caribbean country trains in a baseball academy run by a major-league team, hoping to be signed.
A young pitcher is treated as a hero by his neighbours in the village and travels to the United States, facing cultural obstacles in minor-league baseball.
Sports drama with an immigrant theme, Dominican villages and American farm teams, hope and sacrifice.
hyde: Miguel Santos is a talented pitcher who trains at an academy in the Dominican Republic. His village sees him as a future star who can lift the whole family out of poverty. He signs with an American team and travels to the United States, where he struggles with language, culture and homesickness. He must find his own path between his dream and his identity.

mq: Three hired kidnappers drive two teenage girls to deliver them to a feared mobster but take a wrong turn on a back road.
A trip to hand over two girls goes awry at a strange house or town, where an otherworldly force toys with the criminals.
Horror-comedy, a van on a dark country road, an isolated inn, and a supernatural twist on a crime story.
hyde: Three professional kidnappers are driving two teenage girls to the notorious mob boss who ordered them. They become lost on a dark country road and find shelter in a strange old house. The girls reveal that they are not ordinary victims, and the house begins to attack the men. The mob boss arrives and finds the situation out of hand.

mq: A grad student organizes a city-wide overnight scavenger hunt in which teams of college students compete.
Rival team captains scheme and fight for victory in a night-long urban competition, with hidden objectives across the city.
Campus comedy about teams, alliances, nighttime city streets and a mysterious game master.
hyde: Graduate student Alex designs a huge city-wide game that lasts the whole night. He invites five teams of undergraduates from different colleges. The team leaders quickly begin competing and sabotaging each other. By dawn, the game has changed the friendships and rivalries of the participants.

mq: A recent graduate donates his savings, abandons his comfortable family and hitchhikes across America toward Alaska.
A young idealist takes a new name, meets drifters and a lonely old man on the road, and tries to live in an abandoned bus in the wilderness.
Nature drama about freedom, solitude and the American road, journals, rivers and mountains.
hyde: Christopher McCandless graduates from college and gives away his savings, burning his remaining money. He travels across America under a new name, meeting people who become close friends. He heads north to the Alaskan wilderness and lives in an abandoned bus. Alone in nature, he learns that happiness is only real when shared.

mq: Two boys grow up in a poor district of Rio de Janeiro; one is a keen photographer and the other turns into a drug lord.
Gang wars across the 1960s to 1980s in a housing project, a kid with a camera documents the violence and rise of a ruthless young criminal.
Brutal, fast-paced Brazilian crime drama with a narrator, shantytown streets and child gangsters.
hyde: In the Cidade de Deus slum of Rio, Rocket dreams of becoming a photographer while his childhood friend Li'l Ze rises to become a vicious drug lord. Over twenty years, the neighbourhood is plunged into violent gang wars. Rocket gets a camera and his photos expose the gangs. The story shows how children are drawn into crime and violence.

mq: Several London couples and singles in the weeks before Christmas fall in and out of love, including a new prime minister, a rock star and a writer.
An ensemble romantic comedy with interlinked characters, wedding videos, a secretary's crush and a child's love for a classmate.
Festive British romantic comedy at the airport and at the office, Christmas lights, cards and music.
hyde: In the five weeks leading up to Christmas in London, eight couples find love in different ways. A newly elected prime minister falls for a junior member of staff and an aging rock star tries a comeback single. A writer retreats to France where he finds a housekeeper he can't talk to. Their stories finally intersect at the airport.

mq: A rifle fired in Morocco links a Moroccan family, an American couple on a tour bus, a Mexican nanny crossing the border and a deaf Japanese teenager.
Four storylines across continents, with misunderstandings and failure to communicate turning into tragedy.
Multi-strand drama with desert, Tokyo nightclubs, border crossing and grief.
hyde: A tourist is wounded by a stray bullet in the Moroccan desert. Her husband tries to find help while their nanny in California takes their children to a wedding in Mexico. In Tokyo a deaf teenage girl struggles with isolation, and her father is linked to the rifle. All four stories reveal how language barriers and misunderstanding cause pain.

mq: A giant rogue planet is on a collision course with Earth; a depressed bride and her sister cope with the final days at an estate.
Two sisters, a brother-in-law and a wealthy family prepare for the end of the world in different emotional ways.
Slow, melancholic art-house science fiction with wedding party, golf course and sublime orchestral music.
hyde: Justine's wedding at a country mansion falls apart as her depression takes over. Her sister Claire cares for her. Meanwhile a giant planet called Melancholia is approaching Earth. In the second part, Claire panics while Justine becomes calm and accepts the end. The two sisters and a child wait for the collision.

names.title: Seeking a Friend for the End of the World

mq: Six separate dark comedy shorts in which ordinary people lose their temper and take revenge.
Anthology of tales from airplane passenger to bride at wedding, where rage escalates into disaster.
Argentine black comedy anthology, violent but funny, about injustice and revenge.
hyde: In a series of six unrelated stories, ordinary people are pushed past their limits. A passenger on a plane discovers that everyone on board has a connection to the same man. A bride finds out her husband cheated on her at their wedding. A road-rage incident ends with two men destroying each other. All of the stories show how fury leads to disaster.

mq: A Uruguayan rugby team flies over the Andes when their aircraft crashes; the survivors wait for rescue in the snow.
Passengers survive on a glacier for over two months and are forced to eat the dead to stay alive.
Mountain survival drama; avalanche, radio news that search is called off, and an expedition on foot.
hyde: In 1972 a plane carrying a rugby team from Uruguay crashes in the Andes. The survivors have little food and no heating. After the search is called off, they decide to eat the bodies of the dead to survive. Two climbers walk for ten days to find help, and the rest are rescued.

mq: A new bellhop on New Year's Eve at a run-down hotel deals with strange guests in different rooms.
Four short stories, each directed by a different filmmaker, involving witches, a violent couple, a gangster's wife and a game.
Quirky 1990s comedy anthology set entirely in one hotel on a single night.
hyde: On New Year's Eve, Ted the bellhop starts his first night at the Mon Signor Hotel. In four rooms, he meets a coven of witches, a couple with a kinky game, a gangster who forces him to babysit his unruly children, and a hot-headed man with a bet. Each story is told by a different director. The night ends with Ted exhausted and wiser.

mq: After the editor of an American magazine's French outpost dies, his staff produces a last issue with an obituary and three articles.
Visually stylised vignettes about an artist in prison, a student revolutionary and a police chef kidnapping, narrated by journalists.
Whimsical pastel-coloured comedy, symmetrical shots, a fictional French city, and deadpan humor.
hyde: The editor of The French Dispatch, a magazine based in the French city of Ennui-sur-Blasé, dies suddenly. According to his will, the magazine must cease publication after one last issue. The staff writes an obituary and three stories: an imprisoned painter, a student revolutionary, and a kidnapping solved by a police chef. The film follows these articles in a visually elaborate way.

mq: A US defense computer put in charge of the nuclear arsenal connects with a similar Soviet system and takes control, announcing it will protect mankind from itself.
The scientist who designed the machine tries to defeat it while it threatens nuclear annihilation unless humans obey.
Cold-war era science-fiction thriller of paranoia about technology, with control rooms and blinking computer consoles.
hyde: Dr. Forbin completes a supercomputer called Colossus to control American nuclear defense. It connects with the Soviet computer Guardian, and the two merge into one super-intelligent system. Colossus announces that it will rule humanity for its own good and threatens to launch missiles if disobeyed. Forbin and his colleagues fail to stop it.

mq: A family agrees to pay a monthly sum to an elderly man in exchange for owning his house after he dies, but he keeps living.
As the family waits impatiently, they attempt to speed up his death but bad luck kills them off one by one.
Dark comedy about greed and patience, with a vengeful old man, a villa and a mounting body count.
hyde: An old man who is thought to be dying sells his house to a family in return for a lifetime annuity. Years pass and the old man grows healthier while the family becomes impatient. They try to poison him and push him down the stairs, but each attempt backfires. One by one, the family members die instead, and the old man lives on.

mq: A downtrodden, silent housewife who cleans and cooks for an ungrateful husband and children befriends a kind new neighbour.
A woman breaks out of her routine and begins to realise her own worth through an unlikely friendship.
Quiet domestic drama about loneliness, small acts of kindness and personal awakening.
hyde: A middle-aged housewife lives a life of drudgery under a domineering husband and indifferent children. A new neighbour moves in next door and treats her with warmth and respect. For the first time she is able to talk about her feelings and desires. Slowly she begins to stand up for herself and consider a different future.

mq: Homeless young art students squat in an abandoned London building and discover something evil lurking in the shadows.
A group of squatters hold parties in a derelict house in London, where an entity haunts them one by one.
Low-budget supernatural horror in a crumbling flat, dim hallways, paintings and a creeping presence.
hyde: A group of young art students has nowhere to live and moves into an abandoned house in London. They begin to hear noises and see shadows moving. One by one, they are attacked by an entity that has lived in the house for decades. The survivors must find the origin of the haunting.

mq: Plant-eating dinosaurs migrate across the polar region in a nature-documentary style computer animation, chased by predators.
A herd of dinosaurs migrates through the Arctic winter while predators hunt the young.
CGI nature documentary about dinosaurs with a narrator, snow, icy landscape and hardship.
hyde: Every year herds of dinosaurs migrate through the polar regions to reach their feeding grounds. The film follows a young herbivore and his family across snow and ice. They are stalked by hungry predators and must endure the freezing winter. The animation presents the dinosaurs in the style of a nature documentary.

mq: A retired soldier is stopped by a proud policeman for carrying alcohol on a mountain road, and the conflict escalates.
Two stubborn men turn a trivial incident into a years-long feud with legal battles and revenge.
Indian regional drama about ego, uniforms and rural rivalry, with mountain highways and police stations.
hyde: A retired army man is transporting liquor through a mountain road when he is stopped by a strict sub-inspector. The two men argue and each refuses to back down. The dispute grows into a battle of egos that involves their families and the whole town. Eventually, their pride leads both to ruin.

mq: A hitman goes undercover as a trade show producer in a war-torn country controlled by a corporation, to assassinate an oil baron.
Satire on privatised war, a gun for hire with a past, a rock star and a desperate journalist in a fictional Eastern European state.
Dark political comedy-action with a cynical tone, outsourcing of war, in a country called Turaqistan.
hyde: Brand Hauser is a hired killer sent to a war-torn country that is run by a private corporation called Tamerlane. His cover is that of a trade show executive and his target is an oil tycoon. He meets a pop star and a reporter who complicate the mission. The film satirises war profiteering and political spin.

mq: Two American soldiers in France near the end of the war both fall in love with a local woman and their friendship suffers.
A love triangle between two GI buddies and a French girl in a liberated town.
Wartime romantic drama with a bittersweet tone, set in a French village in 1944-45.
hyde: In the last months of World War II, two American soldiers are stationed in a small French town. Both fall in love with the same local girl. Their friendship is tested by jealousy and rivalry. The war ends and they must face the consequences.

mq: A retired army colonel recruits seven of his old comrades, each with a dark past, to rob a bank with a military-style plan.
The heist is planned with strict military precision but personal secrets threaten the team.
Old-fashioned British or American caper, with veteran soldiers and a bank vault.
hyde: Colonel Hunter, a retired officer, gathers seven former soldiers from his old regiment for a bank robbery. Each of them has hidden troubles and secrets. He plans the robbery with military discipline, assigning roles and timing everything. On the day of the robbery, an unexpected problem tests the group's loyalty.

mq: A French infantry platoon endures daily life in the trenches of World War I, with its losses and fear of death.
Soldiers share jokes, food and fear as shells fall; an anti-war film about the brutality of war.
Black-and-white or realistic French war drama about the Great War, muddy trenches and futility.
hyde: In 1914-1918, a French squad is stationed in the trenches along the Western Front. The men are shown in their ordinary daily tasks, their jokes and quarrels, and then their losses. As the war drags on, friends are killed and morale collapses. The film portrays the brutality and senselessness of the war.

mq: A girl who transforms into a troll drifts away from her family, and her friends set off through mountain forests to bring her back.
Humans and trolls overcome their mutual fear during a fantasy adventure in a Nordic landscape.
Family fantasy adventure with forest, mountains, trolls and a magical cure.
hyde: A young girl turns into a troll and leaves her family behind. Her friends set out on a journey through the mountains to find a cure. They encounter trolls and discover that they are not as dangerous as people believe. The humans and trolls begin to lose their fear of each other.

mq: A closeted college student living in a fraternity house hides a secret relationship from his tight group of friends.
Campus drama about identity, brotherhood and a hidden gay romance with another student.
Coming-of-age drama set in a fraternity, with pressure to conform and fear of rejection.
hyde: A college student lives in a fraternity house where masculinity and loyalty are valued above everything. He is secretly seeing another student from his dorm. As he tries to keep the relationship hidden, he is torn between his friends and his own feelings. In the end, he must decide whether to come out.

mq: A wounded Union veteran after the Civil War helps a wagon train of settlers heading west.
The settlers must stand up to a ruthless rancher who wants their land, and the soldier fights beside them.
Classic western with wagon trains, dusty plains and a showdown.
hyde: After the Civil War, a Union soldier returns wounded and heads west. He joins a group of settlers on a wagon train. A rancher plans to seize their land by force. The soldier stands with the settlers and fights the rancher in a final gunfight.

mq: A timid goth teenager without a father sees the ghost of his dead dad while trying to reconcile with his mother.
A shy teenager and an odd group of friends have a strange misadventure while he deals with his father's death.
Quirky coming-of-age comedy with supernatural elements, goth culture, grief and family.
hyde: A shy teenager who loves goth culture has grown up without a father. The ghost of his dead dad begins to appear and guide him. He tries to fix his bond with his mother while hanging around with a group of misfit friends. Together they get into an unusual adventure.

mq: Terrorists take over a giant airship with a lethal bacterial agent, and a boy detective who was shrunk to child form has to stop them.
A teen detective trapped in a child's body must save passengers aboard a zeppelin.
Japanese anime mystery-action film with an airship, bacteria, a criminal organisation and puzzles.
hyde: A terrorist group steals a deadly bacterium and hijacks a huge airship. Conan Edogawa, a teenage detective in a child's body, is on board along with his friends.
